BiblicalUsage: Artaxerxes writes that whatever the God of heaven commands must be diligently done for his house, lest there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons. The word is the rage itself — and a heathen king fears it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a pagan king can see that God's wrath is not to be provoked, and Artaxerxes' warning is wiser than he knew.
